posts.en:
dsh-plugins#dsh-lan-gateway is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. Complete LAN/remote access for the Web UI: 0.0.0.0 binding, crypto.randomUUID polyfill, token gate (401 login page + WebSocket interception, loopback exempt), privileged-fence and settings-persistence exemptions, and an idempotent installer with upgrade recovery.

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-4330285cd52e8fb0889b.html
